records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to either outreach (email:c59de9d7, email:028852d6) or tickets. Starter plan, fully passive account; 8 days left. Silent non-starters rarely self-activate, though some chance Victor returns on his own.

draft.subject: Getting your first Ridge Dynamics project going
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

I wanted to check in now that your Wrenfield workspace has been open a week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so setting up one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how Ridge Dynamics works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Nadia
